falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within the next 14 trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern typically featured shallow drawdowns with 4,800 as critical support; a decisive break below invalidates the structural similarity and suggests a deeper correction than the pattern implies

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for two consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom was characterized by VIX peaking near 28-30 and rapidly mean-reverting; sustained elevation above 35 indicates panic dynamics inconsistent with the pattern's volatility regime, undermining the bottom formation thesis

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield curve uninverts and steepens by more than 25 basis points (10Y yield rises >2Y yield by 25bps+ from current levels)
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern occurred with a deeply inverted curve; a rapid steepening would signal recession acceleration or financial stress that contradicts the soft-landing stabilization narrative embedded in the pattern match

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
